Per-age ARIMA and ETS models

Source: R/model-series.R
arima_series.Rd

Benchmarks that model the log death rate of every age as a separate time series with forecast: arima_series() selects an ARIMA model with forecast::auto.arima() (drift allowed), ets_series() an exponential smoothing state space model without seasonality with forecast::ets() (damped trends allowed). Draws are simulated future paths of the fitted models (simulate(..., future = TRUE)), so uncertainty grows with the horizon. Ages are simulated independently; parameter uncertainty is not included.

Usage

arima_series(..., bootstrap = FALSE)

ets_series(..., bootstrap = FALSE)

Arguments

...

Arguments passed to forecast::auto.arima() or forecast::ets().

bootstrap

Simulate with resampled residuals instead of normal errors.

Value

A model specification.

References

Hyndman RJ, Khandakar Y (2008). Automatic time series forecasting: the forecast package for R. Journal of Statistical Software 27(3): 1-22. doi:10.18637/jss.v027.i03

Examples

if (requireNamespace("forecast", quietly = TRUE)) {
  x <- mt_example(deaths = "single", years = 2000:2019)
  fc <- mt_forecast(mt_fit(ets_series(), x), h = 3, n_draws = 20, seed = 1)
}
